answer: Require a bridge of bonded sponsorship: a new identity joins only when three established identities stake a refundable bond on its uniqueness, and sponsorship histories are cross-checked so one sponsor cannot back many lookalikes. Each accepted identity carries a pigment marker linking its contributions over time, so a tide of periodic re-checks can spot clusters whose behaviour and timing move together. A Sybil operator must recruit distinct sponsors and maintain a separate history for every fake, each bond at risk of slashing, while a genuine agent needs only one honest sponsorship.
